title: Quenched Canadian Flour Flatbread
description: A fluffy yeast flatbread infused with umami-rich nuka-pickle brine, perfect for gatherings.

ingredients.name: Lactose-free yogurt
ingredients.notes: adds a creamy tang and keeps dough moist

instructions: In a large bowl combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Add warm water and olive oil, then stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Fold in the nuka-pickle brine and yogurt, mixing until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let the dough rise for 45 minutes, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into six equal portions.
Roll each portion into a flat circle about 1.5 cm thick.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and cook each flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and puffy.
Serve warm with additional nuka-pickle or your favorite toppings.
